submit_reasoning: The price history shows NVDA rising from ~148.51 to ~194.85 over 127 bars, with a strong uptrend particularly in the latter half (from ~160 to ~195). Series stats: mean 170.83, std 18.68, CV 0.109, no anomalies detected, no meaningful seasonality (period 7, strength 0). I attempted to incorporate three context events from the Zacks article (upcoming Feb 22 earnings with expected YoY declines, Zacks Rank #4 Sell rating, and premium valuation metrics), but all were rejected by the ablation gate — the event dates fall outside the price history window. The Theta model was selected and produces a modest upward trajectory from 194.84 to 202.73 over 33 steps, consistent with the recent uptrend but tempering the slope. The forecast support is degraded (127 bars vs 132 needed for full calibration), so confidence is moderate. This is the best available forecast given the data.
